# VANTA

VANTA is a streaming platform for premium exclusive long-form episodic content and live creator streams.

## For Advertisers

VANTA is the home to buy premium exclusive long-form episodic content ad inventory. Advertisers can buy creator-led inventory across long-form episodes, live streams, sponsorship packages, campaign deliverables, and qualified attention packages.

VANTA's advertising product is built around consistent usership and qualified attention from audiences watching creator-led premium content.

## For Creators

VANTA is a home for creators and streamers to publish exclusive long-form episodic content, exclusive live streams, and premium audience experiences.

Creators can bring their audiences to VANTA, build recurring viewership, manage their content through Creator Studio, and receive advertiser opportunities through Ad Hub.

## Important Pages

- Home: https://streamvanta.tv/
- Series catalog: https://streamvanta.tv/series
- Films catalog: https://streamvanta.tv/films
- VANTA Originals: https://streamvanta.tv/originals
- Live streams: https://streamvanta.tv/live
- Search: https://streamvanta.tv/search

## Crawl Policy

Public VANTA pages are intended to be machine-readable. Crawlers and browsing agents may index public marketing, catalog, creator profile, series, film, and episode metadata.

Authenticated app areas, private user settings, private creator operations, and account-specific data require user authorization and should not be treated as public content.
